title: Code and data for: Distinct activation mechanisms underlie ligand efficacy at a GPCR
description: Code and input data reproducing every figure in a deep mutational pharmacology study of the human mu-opioid receptor (OPRM1). Approximately 400,000 measurements of variant effects on signalling and surface expression were collected across 15 opioid ligands spanning the efficacy spectrum, including full concentration-response mutational scans for morphine, fentanyl and DAMGO. The repository contains one folder per main and supplemental figure (scripts, rendered panels and a panel-by-panel README), all input tables and structures under data/, the shared upstream pipeline, and a consolidated eight-sheet supplementary data workbook.
